Municipal Government Act, Meeting Procedures Act, COVID-19 suppression regulation. Municipal Government Act revised statutes of Alberta 2000, chapter M26, section 603, ministerial regulations. In order to allow municipalities to adhere to the new restrictions related to COVID-19 pandemic, the province passed the meeting procedure COVID-19 suppression regulation to modify the Municipal Government Act regulations for meetings in support of physical distancing recommendations from the Chief Medical Officer of Health. The regulation gives municipalities greater flexibility for conducting meetings and public hearings electronically. The proposed bylaw sets out temporary procedure provisions for public hearings, public presentations, and open house presentations.
